description: Set environment variables on an app or agent. plain_vars sets plain configuration, name to value, at once; plain values are readable from the dashboard, so never put a secret in plain_vars. For a secret, such as an API key, pass its name in secret_names and say plainly in reason why it is needed: the answer carries a request whose url the person opens, signed in to Valet, to enter each value. Valet stores each as an encrypted secret when they do. Give the person the url, then follow the request with get_request. Never ask the person to type a secret into this conversation. A call may carry both plain_vars and secret_names. Setting a name that exists replaces its value, which is why this is destructive. The process sees plain values on its next start, and restarts once when the person completes the request. The answer names variables and never values. Requires connecting a Valet account.

name.description: Required. The app's or agent's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

plain_vars.description: Plain configuration to set at once, as variable name to value, such as LOG_LEVEL to debug. Readable from the dashboard: never a secret.

reason.description: Required with secret_names. One plain sentence, shown to the person on the request page, saying why the value is needed, such as: The app charges cards and needs your Stripe key. At most 280 characters.

secret_names.description: Names of secret variables, such as STRIPE_KEY, for the person to enter on the request page. Never values.

name: set_env_vars
title: Set environment variables
